label: Collapsible Row
purpose: Accordion/collapsible content row with heading, icon, and expandable body text
_notes:
Block name is 'collapsible-row' NOT 'accordion'. 'content' is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. 'icon' is free text — a Material Symbols icon name (e.g. check_box, local_shipping, verified, star) — NOT a limited enum. custom_icon optionally replaces it with an uploaded image (left empty by the AI per system prompt). filled_icon toggles solid vs outline icon style. open controls whether this row starts expanded — useful for surfacing the most important FAQ/info row by default. Real schema also lets content come from a linked Shopify page ('page' setting) instead of the richtext field — omitted since the AI has no real page to reference. Does NOT support nested content blocks for AI-authored copy — use the 'content' setting directly. All remaining real settings (collapse icon style, borders, corner radius, extensive open/closed state color overrides, padding, animation speed, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
